name: Write a Persian how-to article that does not read as AI output
query: یک مقاله‌ی آموزشی فارسی حدود ۱۲۰۰ کلمه درباره‌ی اینکه چرا افزونه‌ی کش برای کاربران لاگین‌شده کار نمی‌کند بنویس. باید کاملاً انسانی بخوانده شود.
expected_behavior: Step 1: Confirm language, article type, reader, length, and sources; propose defaults instead of stalling
Step 2: Write the one-sentence promise and the single claim before any prose
Step 3: Build a how-to skeleton with a format and word budget per section, per references/structure-patterns.md
Step 4: Open with one of the six patterns in references/openings.md, never with «در دنیای امروز»
Step 5: Draft with varied sentence length, at least one explicit stance and one admitted limitation
Step 6: Run scripts/humanize_lint.mjs with --lang fa and fix every error
Step 7: Walk references/editorial-checklist.md and mark unsourced claims with [نیازمند منبع]
Step 8: Deliver Markdown with YAML front matter including excerpt, image_brief, and needs_source
success_criteria: humanize_lint.mjs exits 0 on the delivered draft
No banned phrase from references/ai-tells.md §1 appears
Sentence-length standard deviation is at least 6
ZWNJ is used correctly in می/نمی and ها/تر forms; no Arabic ي or ك
At least one first-person judgement and one admitted limitation appear
No invented statistics; unsourced claims are explicitly flagged
Front matter includes an image brief handed off to featured-image-art-direction
